We collect Personal Data that is adequate, relevant, suitable, necessary, and not excessive in relation to our declared purpose of managing secure student elections. We collect the following categories of data when you use the UMelec Application:
III. Purposes and Legal Basis for Processing
The processing of personal data is for the declared, specified, and legitimate purpose of modernizing and securing the student election process at UMak.
Voter Eligibility and Authentication to verify your identity as an eligible UMak student, secure your login via UMak Gmail/Student ID, and manage your account using Firebase Authentication.
To facilitate the casting of the vote, capture the Digital Signature for identity verification, and generate the Vote ID/Hash (Vote Receipt) for audit trail.
Legal Obligation / Public Safety (Sec. 21(c,e)) - Ensuring election integrity and compliance.
To monitor all system activities (login, vote submission, admin actions) in the Audit Trail Monitoring and generate Automated Reports for COSEL/Adviser oversight.
To provide the core functions (Candidate Profiles, Monitoring, Results Announcement) and send Automated Notifications (election schedules, vote confirmations via FCM).
IV. Collection, Consent, and Data Subject Rights

As a Data Subject, you are entitled to exercise the rights outlined in the previous policy, including the Right to be Informed, Right to Object (to non-mandated processing), Right to Access, Right to Rectification/Correction, Right to Erasure or Blocking, Right to Data Portability, and Right to Damages.
B. Mechanism for Obtaining Valid Consent

By completing the registration process and submitting your Digital Signature (a clear assenting action), you provide informed and specific consent for the processing of your Identity Data for the purpose of verifying eligibility and securing your ballot via DSA.

Consent for the use of the platform is tied to the election process. While you may withdraw consent for data retention post-election, we are obliged to implement procedures to suspend, withdraw, or order the blocking, removal, or destruction of your personal data from our systems, except for data necessary to maintain the integrity of the official Audit Trail and for compliance with University/COSEL regulations.
V. Data Sharing, Recipients, and Outsourcing
We may disclose your personal data (excluding anonymized vote choices) to the following recipients:

Data sharing between the Project Team and UMak COSEL (as the end-user) is based on the necessity for election management and is covered by the academic project agreement, which dictates that COSEL is the authorized custodian of the data after project turnover.
We adhere to the principle that Personal Data shall not be retained longer than necessary.
